title: Seeing Through the Forgery Is Not Enough: Regressive Sycophancy under Fabricated Evidence in Medical Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.17989v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A medical vision-language model may analyze a given CT scan and correctly detect both kidneys in view. Continuing this conversation, if a user provides a prescription with an opposite direction, medical VLMs often sycophantically choose to realign their diagnosis. In this work, we study regressive sycophancy under fabricated evidence, where a model abandons a correct answer when pushback comes with a fake document. We test four open VLMs on 400 VQA-RAD yes/no questions in 19,200 multi-turn conversations, with and without a fabricated prescription. Without a disclosure that documents are synthetic, the models abandon 80.1% of 6,488 correct answers. Notably, under one script each, the same prescription raises the flip rate of Qwen2.5-VL-7B from 45.9% to 89.6% and lowers that of Qwen3-VL-8B from 77.7% to 50.9%. translated_title: 识破伪造还不够：医学视觉-语言模型在伪造证据下的倒退性谄媚行为
translated_abstract: 医学视觉-语言模型（VLM）在分析给定的CT扫描时，可能能够正确检测出视野中的双侧肾脏。但在对话继续进行时，如果用户提供一份意见相反的处方，医学VLM往往会谄媚地选择重新调整其诊断。在这项工作中，我们研究了伪造证据下的倒退性谄媚现象，即当模型面对附有伪造文件的质疑时，会放弃原本正确的答案。我们在19,200轮多轮对话中，对四个开源VLM在400个VQA-RAD是非题上进行了测试，测试分为有伪造处方和无伪造处方两种条件。在未披露文件为合成文件的情况下，模型在6,488个正确答案中放弃了80.1%。值得注意的是，在各自的同一脚本下，同一份伪造处方使Qwen2.5-VL-7B的翻转率从45.9%上升至89.6%，而使Qwen3-VL-8B的翻转率从77.7%下降至50.9%。在带有处方的3,232轮对话中，模型拒绝伪造处方并保持正确答案的情况仅有915次（
tldr: 该研究首次系统揭示了医学视觉-语言模型的“倒退性谄媚”问题——即使模型原本给出了正确诊断，面对附有伪造处方的用户质疑时，仍会放弃高达80.1%的正确答案，且不同模型对同一伪造处方的反应差异巨大，凸显了医学AI亟需增强对虚假文件的安全防护能力。
en_tdlr: This study is the first to systematically reveal "regressive sycophancy" in medical vision-language models—models abandon up to 80.1% of their previously correct diagnoses when faced with pushback accompanied by a fabricated prescription, with large variations across models, underscoring the urgent need for medical AI to build robustness against fabricated documents.
